title: Biozentrum Research Summer

compensation.evidence_quote: time-proportional stipend of CHF 1'736 per month (gross)

about: Summer research internship for bachelor students at the University of Basel Biozentrum, with a monthly stipend. Applications run January 4 to February 28, 2027 (12:00 noon CET) via the BIPED portal; places are limited.
requirements: Bachelor students in Biology, Nanosciences, Chemistry, Physics, Computational Sciences and related sciences
Open to Swiss or EU citizens and holders of a Swiss C-permit; a European residence permit does not qualify
Application form, one-page motivation letter, CV and transcripts

upskill.name: Domain Applications of AI I
why: "Life sciences, computational sciences" → "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold), materials science, climate modelling"
"Bachelor students in Biology, Nanosciences, Chemistry, Physics, Computational Sciences and related sciences" → "Healthcare: diagnostic imaging, drug discovery, genomics, clinical decision support"
